import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        boolean[] used = new boolean[p];
        int t = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                t++;
                int cur = i;
                while (!used[cur]) {
                    used[cur] = true;
                    cur = (int)(((long)cur * k) % p);
                }
            }
        }
        long ans = 1;
        int limit = t + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < limit; i++) {
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
